steps.description: Search for the private task by searching for the target problem's number (frame.wait_for_selector(f"[aria-label='Preview record: {target_problem_number}']").click()).
Click on the private task to open it (frame.get_by_text("Open Record").click()).
Close the pop-up to edit the duplicate problem in the same window (frame.get_by_text("Close").last.click()).

Fill the 'duplicate_of' field with the source problem's number and press Enter (frame.locator('[aria-labelledby="label.problem.duplicate_of"]').fill(source_problem['number']); page.keyboard.press("Enter")).
Click 'update' to save the problem record, marking the target problem as a duplicate of the source problem (frame.get_by_text("update").first.click()).
